label: D1 late in the episode (trials ~88-99), mostly after reward
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2) and almost only late in the episode: 62% of activation mass is in trials 90-99 and 14% in 80-89, with the rate rising steadily before that. It is strongly tied to the reward input. in_rew == 1 carries 89% of the mass, though rewarded D1 alone is very imprecise (P = 0.14). It also tracks the model value being low (the lowest value bin holds 64% of the mass), which reflects the value head falling as the episode end nears. The predicate D1 & ep_trial >= 88 gives dev F1 0.61 (P 0.59, R 0.63). Adding in_rew == 1 (with ep_trial >= 85) or using value < 5.2 gives about the same F1 (0.60-0.62), so the simplest time-based predicate was recorded. Misses are rewarded D1 steps earlier in the episode, with weak activations. False positives are late D1 steps, mostly unrewarded. The unit does not fire on unrewarded early D1 steps or on any GO/D2 step. Magnitude follows the same pattern: coverage is similar across activation quartiles, and the top windows are rewarded D1 steps at the window end. Only observed variables are used: episode time is implicit in the recurrent state.
